cohort: the 200 certified confirmation boards, four fixed recipes × 50 boards

evidence.tuning_source: prior ACR v1.0 online ledger and distinct offline profiling episodes
evidence.prior_incidence: multi_slack and multi_tight dominate UNKNOWN; last_short may instead be known unsafe
evidence.unit: exact state/action and a complete natural quota trajectory to a stable successor
evidence.candidate_priority: repeated unresolved stable successors on actual ACR profiling paths first, using quotas and deterministic tie breaks
evidence.safety: accept only a stable terminal meeting goal or a verified certificate matching exact stable successor, replay the full wave trajectory independently
evidence.base: reconstruct prior frozen bank and keep original v1.0 forecasts; independent matched audit does not change base planning
evidence.targeted: offline verified expansion followed by frozen support; update Z_cert forecast from independent matched state/action audits; do not change dynamic K formula or cap
evidence.evaluation: separate audit/tuning and gameplay draws; same matched audit queries to base and v1.1
evidence.distortion: UNKNOWN stays distinct from known unsafe; no claim to have enumerated the true safe set

benchmark.clock: thread CPU time for decisions and separate steady-clock wall time; offline solve and telemetry costs are reported separately
benchmark.color_metric: mean position color TV against fixed natural quotas among first waves of size 3, 4 or 5, standardized by Fixed6 first-wave sizes in the same bank/cache mode

bootstrap.resample: paired certified board within each fixed recipe

gates_for_targeted_adaptive.report: require checks in both cache settings; report point estimates and paired intervals. Color tolerance is a study-defined one-point measurement margin; report exact point relation separately. Without true service tests and stable calibration actual deployment is a separate decision.

difficulty.production: preserve fixed witness and original 120 entries
difficulty.research: bind v1.1 profile version to its own thresholds from original 100 boards; validate on the previous tier-pool 200 seeds, disjoint from evaluation and calibration boards
